verdict.rationale: Factory supports mentioning/assigning @Factory in Linear or Jira issue comments/tickets to delegate a task for Droid to investigate and implement, which is analogous to tagging an agent in a thread — but this is evidenced only for Linear/Jira issue comments, not for a generic 'chat thread' or Slack/PR conversation context. missing for 10: evidence of @-mentioning Factory in a live chat/Slack thread or PR discussion thread (not just issue trackers), and confirmation this works for general bug/task discussion rather than just issue assignment.
